classes.name: LessEqualBinary
classes.description: Represents the '<=' binary operator node in Twig's expression syntax, handling code generation for 'less than or equal' comparisons within Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for evaluating the less-than-or-equal binary operation, with special handling for PHP 8.0+ by delegating to the parent implementation, otherwise using a custom comparison method.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representing the operator, which is '<=' in this case.
